name: ibis Styles Semarang Simpang Lima
short_description: A 127-room hotel set directly above a shopping and dining centre at the Pancasila Simpang Lima roundabout, one minute from the culinary district.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Semarang Simpang Lima occupies a landmark position right at the Pancasila Square Simpang Lima roundabout, built above a shopping and dining centre in the heart of Semarang. The 127-room property offers 7 room types plus the 3rd-floor STREATS restaurant and four meeting rooms, and is a one-minute walk from the Simpang Lima culinary area, 5 minutes from Lawang Sewu and Jalan Pandanaran. Guests consistently call out the strategic, walkable location, clean rooms with comfortable beds, and friendly, responsive service, with breakfast and room service also drawing praise. As with its sister property nearby, the main gripe in reviews is limited elevator capacity during busy periods.

faqs.question: Where is ibis Styles Semarang Simpang Lima located?
faqs.answer: The hotel sits directly at the Pancasila Square Simpang Lima roundabout in central Semarang, built above a shopping and dining centre. It is a one-minute walk from the Simpang Lima culinary area and about 5 minutes from Lawang Sewu and the Jalan Pandanaran souvenir district.

faqs.question: How many rooms does ibis Styles Semarang Simpang Lima have?
faqs.answer: The hotel has 127 rooms spread across 7 different room types, all on a 100% non-smoking property, positioned as a colorful, design-forward ibis Styles option aimed at both leisure travelers and business guests visiting Simpang Lima.

faqs.question: Does ibis Styles Semarang Simpang Lima have meeting facilities?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the hotel has four meeting rooms, with the largest spanning 265 square meters and holding up to 264 guests conference-style or 120 banquet-style, plus the STREATS restaurant on the 3rd floor that seats up to 100 for dining and events.
